text: Irakli Kobakhidze - Just as the Prime Minister, the State Minister will also be fully served by the resources of the Government Administration; there is nothing to mock here, though the opposition still manages to engage in speculation on this as well — that is their style and it is not interesting (28.04.2026, 16:17)

Just like the Prime Minister, the Deputy Prime Minister and the State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will also be fully served by the resources of the Government Administration — you can see for yourselves that there is nothing to mock here, although the opposition is once again managing to spread speculation — that is their style and it is not interesting,” Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze said in a statement to journalists.
According to him, the purpose of creating the new structural unit is to further strengthen the law enforcement system.

“These changes were intended to further strengthen the law enforcement system. A new link has emerged — the coordination link. Mamuka Mdinaradze had already been performing this function before, but from a specific agency. That was the factual situation. We decided to formalize the arrangement that is correct, that had already been established before. In reality, there will be independent structures. Naturally, these are the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the State Security Service, the Special State Protection Service, and it will ensure their overall coordination. The position of state minister is a new post designated for this, which will further strengthen the fight against crime and the effort to maintain public order. You know that over this one year we have fundamental changes in every direction,” Kobakhidze said.

At the same time, the Prime Minister answered a question about parallels between the former head of the State Security Service, Grigol Liluashvili, who is in custody, and Mamuka Mdinaradze, and noted that “back then the process unfolded differently; now it will unfold differently.”

“The situation is radically different. The context is completely different. Mamuka Mdinaradze is an exceptionally successful member of our team. Specifically, his work in the State Security Service was exceptionally successful, including in the areas of corruption and terrorist crime. He implemented very important systemic changes. This is a different background, and therefore future developments will also be different,” Kobakhidze said.

The Parliament is considering, under an expedited procedure, a draft law on the basis of which the position of State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies is being introduced within the composition of the Government of Georgia. According to the draft, the Government Administration will provide the new State Minister’s activities with material, technical, and organizational support.

According to the Parliamentary Secretary of the Government, Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the powers of the State Minister will be specified in a government resolution. He also said that the State Minister for coordination of law enforcement agencies will be located in the Government Administration building.
